name: chrome-bridge
description: Local Codex bridge for controlling the active Chrome tab through a companion extension.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to your active Chrome tab through localhost.
interface.longDescription: Adds a local MCP bridge plus a companion Chrome extension so Codex can inspect, scroll, click, type, and read the currently active Chrome tab in real time.
defaultPrompt: Use Chrome Bridge to inspect my active tab.
Scroll the current page and summarize what changed.
Click a selector in Chrome and tell me the result.
